The season started on 31 October 2020 as a consequence of the postponement of the previous season's conclusion due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |title=اتحاد كرة القدم يعلن مواعيد فترات تسجيل اللاعبين للموسم الجديد |url=https://ajel.sa/pZ2mWN/}} Fixtures for the first half of the 2020–21 season were announced on 3 October 2020.{{cite web |title=أصدرت لجنة المسابقات في رابطة #الدوري_السعودي_للمحترفين جدول الدور الأول |url=https://twitter.com/M_S_League/status/1312428144201216002}} Fixtures for the second half were announced on 18 January 2021.{{cite web |title=المسابقات تحدد مواعيد مباريات الدور الثاني من دوري الدرجة الأولى للمحترفين |url=https://msl.sa/ar/node/1459}} The first team to be promoted was [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]], following their 4–2 away win against [[Al-Sahel FC|Al-Sahel]] on 20 April. They set the record for the earliest team to secure promotion with six games remaining as well as most points, most wins and most goals in a season.{{cite web |title=رسمياً: الحزم أول الصاعدين إلى دوري الكبار برقم قياسي جديد|url=https://www.dawriplus.com/news/53304-%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B2%D9%85-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A5%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85-%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF.html}} On 21 May, Al-Hazem secured their second title following a 1–0 away win against [[Hajer FC|Hajer]].{{cite web |title=رياضي / فريق الحزم بطلاً لدوري الدرجة الأولى .. والفيحاء ثاني الصاعدين |url=https://www.spa.gov.sa/2230049}} The second team to be promoted was [[Al-Fayha FC|Al-Fayha]], following 0–0 home draw with [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] on 20 May.{{cite web |title=الفيحاء.. عودة سريعة إلى المحترفين |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/730375}} The final team to be promoted was [[Al-Tai FC|Al-Tai]] who were promoted on the final matchday following a 2–0 away win over [[Arar FC|Arar]].{{cite A total of 20 teams are contesting the league, including 13 sides from the [[2019–20 Prince Mohammad bin Salman League|2019–20 season]], 4 promoted teams from the [[2019–20 Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] and the three relegated sides from the [[2019–20 Saudi Professional League|Pro League]]. The first club to be relegated to the MS League was [[Al-Adalah FC|Al-Adalah]], who were relegated after only a year in the top flight following a 1–1 home draw with [[Al-Raed FC|Al-Raed]].{{cite web |title=العدالة يهبط رسمياً إلى دوري الدرجة الأولى إثر تعادله مع الرائد |url=http://www.alriyadh.com/1839391}} On 4 September 2020, [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]] became the second club to be relegated, ending a 2-year stay in the Pro League following a 1–0 defeat away to [[Al-Shabab FC (Riyadh)|Al-Shabab]].{{cite web |title=المرة الثانية.. الحزم يهبط |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/700875}} On 9 September 2020, [[Al-Fayha FC|Al-Fayha]] became the third and final club to be relegated following a 1–0 defeat away to [[Al-Taawoun FC|Al-Taawoun]] in the final matchday.{{cite web |title=السهلاوي يهزم الكابوس.. ويفجر الأفراح |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/701373}} Al-Fayha were relegated after three years in the Pro League. The first club to be promoted was [[Hajer FC|Hajer]] who were promoted following a 1–0 home win against [[Al Akhdoud Club|Al-Akhdoud]] on 13 August 2020.{{cite web |title=صعود نادي هجر لدوري الأمير محمد بن سلمان للدرجة الأولى |url=http://www.alriyadh.com/1836596}} The second club to be promoted was [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] following a 1–1 home draw against [[Al-Qaisumah FC|Al-Qaisumah]] on 27 August 2020.{{cite web |title=الدرعية ثاني الصاعدين لـ دوري الدرجة الأولى |url=https://www.almowaten.net/2020/08/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%84%D9%80-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7/}} The third club to be promoted was [[Al-Sahel FC|Al-Sahel]] who were promoted following a 3–0 away win against [[Al-Suqoor FC|Al-Suqoor]] on 28 August 2020.{{cite web |title=دربال.. الصعود الثاني |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/700129}} The fourth and final club to be promoted was [[Arar F.C.|Arar]] who were promoted on the final matchday following a 1–0 away win against [[Al-Sharq Club|Al-Sharq]].{{cite web |title=«عرعر» إلى الأولى بعد 40 عاماً من الانتظار |url=https://www.okaz.com.sa/sport/saudi/2039887}} [[Hajer FC|Hajer]] defeated [[Al-Diriyah Club|Al-Diriyah]] in the final to win their 2nd [[Saudi Second Division|Second Division]] title.{{cite web |title=هجر يتوَّج بطلاً لدوري الدرجة الثانية 2019-2020 |url=https://hajerclub.net/site/?p=32194}} [[Arar F.C.|Arar]] defeated [[Al-Sahel FC|Al-Sahel]] in the third-place playoffs. Al-Sahel and Arar will play in the [[Prince Mohammad bin Salman League]] for the first time in their history. Hajer return after a seasons absence and will play in their 29th overall season in the MS League. Al-Diriyah return to the MS League for the first time since getting relegated in [[2015–16 Saudi First Division|2015–16]] season. They will play in their 4th season in the MS League. [[Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]] and [[Ohod Club|Ohod]] will play in their 30th season in the MS League overtaking [[Al-Taawoun FC|Al-Taawoun's]] record of 29 years in the second tier. ===Stadia and locations===
